sources.authors: de Haan EHF, Corballis PM, Hillyard SA, et al.
sources.title: Split-Brain: What We Know Now and Why This is Important for Understanding Consciousness
sources.relevance: Comprehensive review covering Pinto 2017 findings, IIT/GWT/RPT predictions, cross-cueing debate, unresolved questions
sources.quality: high - review by major contributors including Pinto, Gazzaniga collaborators, and Anil Seth

sources.authors: de Haan EHF, Fabri M, Dijkerman HC, et al.
sources.title: Unified Tactile Detection and Localisation in Split-Brain Patients
sources.relevance: Tactile experiments showing cross-hemispheric access to sensory information without corpus callosum
sources.quality: medium-high - single case (patient DDC), high experimental control

sources.authors: de Haan EHF, Scholte HS, Pinto Y, et al.
sources.title: Singularity and Consciousness: A Neuropsychological Contribution
sources.relevance: Resting-state fMRI in split-brain patient; singularity vs unity distinction; RPT support
sources.quality: medium - single case fMRI, novel theoretical contribution

sources.title: One Brain. Two Minds? Many Questions
sources.relevance: Accessible review of the unified vs split consciousness debate, good historical context
sources.quality: medium - educational review, not primary research

sources.authors: Pinto Y, de Haan EHF, Lamme VAF.
sources.title: The Split-Brain Phenomenon Revisited: A Single Conscious Agent with Split Perception
sources.notes: Abstract only; key findings accessed via PMC7305066 comprehensive review which extensively cites this paper
sources.relevance: Core paper proposing unified consciousness framework; key citation for today's article
sources.quality: high - published in TCS, driven split-brain debate

sources.title: Forty-five years of split-brain research and still going strong
sources.notes: Abstract only; primary findings well-known from extensive secondary literature
sources.relevance: Defines Gazzaniga's classical view of hemispheric independence and interpreter module
sources.quality: high - Nature Reviews, by the pioneer of split-brain research

sources.title: Interaction in Isolation: 50 Years of Insights from Split-Brain Research
sources.relevance: Gazzaniga's perspective on 50 years; defends two-agent view against Pinto
sources.quality: high - Brain journal, by Gazzaniga's team

sources.title: Unraveling the mystery of alien hand syndrome
sources.relevance: Alien hand syndrome mechanisms as window into agency dissociation from consciousness
